answer: Make every new identity enter through a sponsor who puts their own standing on the line. If the newcomer is later caught as a clone, the sponsor loses reputation too, so vouching for a sybil farm burns the very accounts that took years to build. Standing should accrue slowly, like basalt cooling layer by layer, so a farm can't reach its zenith overnight. Over a long horizon, honest sponsors stay picky and fake identities run out of trusted people willing to back them.
